name: skill respec from linked sources lab test
description: PASS/FAIL lines: the skill respec (a node's unlearn, the paid reset) paying its Runes from linked sources (GitHub #150) on a dedicated server started with KILN_STATIONS_CRAFT_LAB=1. A spawned player character with a vanilla node unlearns and resets through the game's own input handler: no Runes anywhere, Runes only in a linked chest, bag first, the bag alone, short, the Magic chest before the link, the paid reset and a reset with nothing spent, each against Kiln's own payment counters.
